skill_workbench_review.summary: The repository exposes a REST onboarding/status surface and includes OpenAPI plus SOAP/WSDL material for contract-level drilldown.
skill_workbench_review.scope: Reviewed controller methods, OpenAPI contract files, SOAP/WSDL resources and example documents.

findings.title: REST entry and contract examples are available for request/response explanation.
findings.description: The controller defines onboarding and status operations while OpenAPI/example files provide human-readable contract evidence.

findings.title: SOAP/WSDL resources are supporting integration contracts.
